title: DIMSTYLE typed text-fill and arc-symbol DXF projection
scope: Parse and emit typed DIMTFILL and DIMARCSYM scalar values for the bounded R2007+ DXF profile
Reject invalid domains and nondefault downgrade loss before output
Project DIMTFILLCLR as the peer-documented second R2007+ group-70 ACI index while preserving the documented first occurrence as table-entry flags
Reject third and later group-70 occurrences, unsupported color methods, and nondefault pre-R2007 downgrade loss
Accept the exact dynamic override key $DIMTFILLCLR for the peer-defined second group-70 field; reject other dynamic aliases using group 70
Record the LibreCAD PR #3269 compatibility regression in the P8-D exit criteria

formatReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.68
formatReferences.finding: The DWG DIMSTYLE field inventory assigns R2007+ DIMTFILL to group 69 and DIMARCSYM to group 90; this is DWG layout evidence, not by itself an Autodesk DXF schema definition.

formatReferences.title: Autodesk DIMARCSYM system variable
formatReferences.finding: DIMARCSYM is an integer with values 0, 1, and 2.

formatReferences.title: Autodesk DIMSTYLE DXF reference
formatReferences.finding: The published DIMSTYLE record schema lists group 70 as table-entry flags and does not list groups 69 or 90. The new 69/90 mapping is therefore treated as peer-documented compatibility, not an Autodesk-documented DXF guarantee.

formatReferences.title: ezdxf DIMSTYLE Table, unofficial R2007+ variables
formatReferences.finding: ezdxf explicitly documents DIMTFILL as group 69 and DIMTFILLCLR as a second group-70 ACI color index, while labeling these fields unofficial and absent from Autodesk's DXF reference.

formatReferences.title: LibreDWG manual, DIMSTYLE fields
formatReferences.finding: The independent open-source implementation documents DIMTFILL group 69 and DIMARCSYM group 90.

formatReferences.title: ezdxf DIMSTYLE table documentation
formatReferences.finding: The R2007+ DIMTFILL mapping is explicitly classified as unofficial; its described values are 0 through 2.

localSource.finding: DIMSTYLE parsing and typed synchronization retain group 69 DIMTFILL, group 90 DIMARCSYM, and the second R2007+ group-70 DIMTFILLCLR ACI index. The first group 70 remains table-entry flags; the second is accepted only for AC1021+ and the third is refused. Typed output and the exact dynamic key $DIMTFILLCLR write the second group 70, with dynamic precedence over typed state. Only index-style colors are projected; RGB/book-color CMC details are refused. Nondefault pre-AC1021 loss is refused.

compatibilityScope.finding: The LibreCAD adapter fix is outside this libdxfrw repository. P8-D now explicitly requires clean-consumer coverage for modified LTYPE definitions, archived DXF/DWG records, preserved table-entry metadata, untouched complex records, and fresh save/readback.

libreCadDimstyleAdapter.finding: The committed LibreCAD adapter registers $DIMTFILLCLR as an integer DIMSTYLE variable and maps it to setExplicitBackgroundFillColor() through DIMSTYLE group 70. libdxfrw now publishes that exact key for the second group-70 peer profile.
libreCadDimstyleAdapter.evidenceLevel: read-only source contract review; not a clean adapter build, runtime import, save/readback, or native color rendering result

focusedTest.result: PASS (1/1; generated ASCII/Binary DIMTFILLCLR typed output/readback, dynamic override precedence/readback, third-occurrence refusal, nonrepresentable RGB CMC atomic refusal and ACI same-writer retry, and typed/dynamic pre-AC1021 atomic refusal with same-writer retry; existing DIMTFILL/DIMARCSYM controls remain green)

consumerCompatibility.result: PASS; public consumer interface compile target

remaining: The group-70 DIMTFILLCLR projection is peer-documented only; Autodesk producer acceptance, true-color/book-color behavior, and native consumer semantics remain unqualified.
Producer-authored and native-consumer validation for the 69/90 compatibility mapping remains open.
LibreCAD PR #3269's adapter regression still needs to be run as part of P8-D clean-consumer qualification.
